chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya narrated from 'Abd Allah ibn Ja'far who said:

I wrote to Abu Muhammad (peace be upon him), asking: 'A woman breastfed a man's son; is it lawful for that man to marry the daughter of this breastfeeding woman or not?' He signed (the answer): 'No, it is not lawful for him.'
ai.seo_question: Can a man marry the daughter of the woman who breastfed him?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies that a woman who breastfeeds a man creates a 'milk-son' relationship, thereby prohibiting marriage to her daughter. It highlights the Shia scholarly consensus that the prohibition extends to the nurse's female offspring, mirroring the status of a biological daughter. This ruling underscores the broader principle that nursing establishes kinship ties comparable to blood relations for the purpose of marriage restrictions.

en.sarwar: 18. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from ‘Abd Allah ibn Ja’far who has said the following:

“I once wrote to abu Muhammad, Alayhi al-Salam, and asked, ‘A woman has breastfed the son of a man; if the man can marry the daughter of breastfeeding woman. He (the Imam) signed the answer, ‘No, he cannot marry because it is not lawful for him.’”
